{{Quote|The first blade. I guard. It rests with the ashes of its maker. The Weapon Master.|One of the droids guarding the hilt of the First Blade|audio=FirstBladeIGuard-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Weapon Master''' was an ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He built the [[First Blade]], which opened the way to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] crafting.<ref name="TOR" />

After their death, the Weapon Master's ashes would remain hidden on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], along with the [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] of the First Blade. The resting place of the Master was rediscovered in the ruined temple-city of [[Kaleth]] millennia later by the [[The Barsen'thor|third Barsen'thor]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Weapon Master was first mentioned in the 2011 video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Due to the nickname, this individual might have been referring to<ref name="TOR" /> [[Tem Madog]], the [[Je'daii Temple Master]] of [[Vur Tepe]] where he crafted tools for the [[Je'daii Order]]; including its weapons.<ref name="DOTJ">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>
